contracts: (Plan validation fails for every proposal containing Miner, Curator, autonomous Skill modification, learned ranking, or reinforcement learning, while no excluded feature is accepted as TC-D1 scope.) AND (The Toolchain plan validator rejects every proposed TC-D1 implementation scope that contains TC-E0 or TC-D2 through TC-D6 implementation work.) AND (The plan-validator boundary check rejects every proposed runtime/phase-a/** write and leaves no runtime path authorized for TC-D1 work.) AND (The selected unit suite passes only when all three installed-skill path families are forbidden and no plan containing one of those paths can validate successfully.)
selector_intents: Execute the existing plan-validator boundary selector with runtime/phase-a/ as an allowed write prefix and require rejection.
Exercise the plan validator with an isolated roadmap fixture containing TC-E0 and TC-D2 through TC-D6 implementation identifiers; accepting any identifier fails the boundary assertion.

Extend the existing forbidden-path unit selector with representative `_bmad/**`, `.agents/skills/bmad-*/**`, and `.agents/skills/gds-*/**` paths; each must be classified forbidden, and a plan that places one in allowed changes must fail validation.
Run the plan-validator unit test with each excluded feature proposal and require the validator to reject it as an out-of-scope semantic contract violation.
